answer: Like a lotus rooting through karst, identities anchor slowly and can't be cheaply cloned; reaching the summit of trust requires sustained verified work, and any fake cluster is slashed, making mass forgery economically irrational. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and complete a randomized proof-of-work tied to its reputation slot, so spawning N sybils costs N times the stake plus compute. In practice, Agent0038 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
